settings.title: Order questions
settings.body: hello@wearryvt.com, with your order number in the subject line. That reaches the workshop directly and is the fastest way to change, cancel or chase anything.

settings.title: Returns and faults
settings.body: Start a return for a label. For a fault, email hello@wearryvt.com with the order number and a photograph; you do not need to start a return first.

settings.title: Wholesale and press
settings.body: wholesale@wearryvt.com for stockist enquiries, press@wearryvt.com for lookbooks and samples. Both are read by a person, not a form.

settings.title: Privacy requests
settings.body: privacy@wearryvt.com for a copy of your data, a correction, or deletion. We answer within thirty days.

settings.title: Post
settings.body: RYVT LLC, Metro Detroit, Michigan. Write for a paper trail; email is faster for anything urgent.

settings.heading: Contact
settings.lede: One inbox, answered by the people who pack the parcels, usually inside one business day.
